titleEn: The Glory of Kings — Christ Foretold in the Law (ch. 96, part 1)
part: ch. 96, part 1 of 2 — Christ Foretold in the Law
about: Chapter 96 opens the Council's prophecies of Christ from the Law: the prophet like Moses (Deuteronomy 18), the bronze serpent as a figure of the cross (Numbers 21), and Israel at Sinai, whose fear of hearing God's word and seeing his face is read as a refusal of Christ.

sentences.i: Chapter 96: Concerning the prophecy of Christ
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፺፮ is the numeral 96. በእንተ 'concerning' + ትንቢት 'prophecy' (feminine noun) + ዘክርስቶስ, ዘ- 'of, that is' + ክርስቶስ 'Christ'. ዘ- here is the genitive marker, so 'the prophecy of Christ'; the chapter shows it means the prophecies concerning him, from the Law.

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ሰበከ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ በኦሪት ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ነቢየ ፡ ያነሥእ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ ዘከማየ ፡ እምአኀዊክሙ ፡ ወስምዕዎ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ነቢይ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ነፍስ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኢትሰምዖ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ነቢይ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ነፍስ ፡ ለትሠሮ ፡ እምሕዝባ ፤
sentences.l: And-again he-proclaimed Moses in-Law and-he-said: prophet he-will-raise for-you like-me from-brothers-your, and-hear-him that prophet; and-every soul which not-it-hears-him that prophet, that soul let-it-be-rooted-out(?) from-people-its;
sentences.i: And again Moses proclaimed in the Law, and said: 'He will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers; hear that prophet. And every soul that does not hear that prophet, let that soul be cut off (?) from its people';
sentences.n: A quotation of Deuteronomy 18:15-19 (compare Acts 3:22-23). ወካዕበ 'and again'. ሰበከ 'he proclaimed' (3ms perfect, G). በኦሪት is በ- 'in' + ኦሪት 'the Law' (the Pentateuch). ወይቤ 'and he said' opens the quotation. ነቢየ is the accusative 'a prophet'; ያነሥእ is 3ms imperfect of አንሥአ 'raise up' (causative stem). ዘከማየ is ዘ- 'who is' + ከማ 'like' + -የ 'me'; እምአኀዊክሙ is እም- 'from' + አኀው 'brothers' (construct form አኀዊ-) + -ክሙ 'your' (2mp). ወስምዕዎ is the 2mp imperative ስምዑ 'hear!' + -ዎ 'him', with the object named after it by ለ- (ለውእቱ ነቢይ 'that prophet'). ነፍስ 'soul' is feminine, so the verb is ኢትሰምዖ 'she does not hear him' (3fs imperfect + -ዎ) and ይእቲ is 'that (f.)'. CRUX: ለትሠሮ is read as ለ- (the 3rd-person jussive particle) + ትሠሮ, 3fs, from ሠረወ 'root out, uproot' (?); the passive sense 'be cut off' is taken from the Deuteronomy/Acts parallel, not shown by the form (?). ሕዝባ is ሕዝብ 'people' + -ኣ 'her/its' (the soul's).

sentences.t: ወዘንተ ፡ ይቤ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወካዕበ ፡ ተነበየ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ስቅለቱ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ሶበ ፡ አመንደብዎሙ ፡ አክይስት ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ አውየዉ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወሙሴሂ ፡ አውየወ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ያድኅኖሙ ፡ እምአርዌ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ግበር ፡ ሣዕለ ፡ ከይሲ ፡ ዘብርት ፡ ወስቅሎ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ይትኤመርዎ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ዘነሰኮ ፡ ከይሲ ፡ ይነጽሮ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ሥዕለ ፡ ብርት ፡ ወይሕየው ፡ ወሶበ ፡ ተህከዩ ፡ ነጽሮ ፡ ይመውቱ ፡ ወእለሰ ፡ ነጸርዎ ፡ ወአምኑ ፡ የሐይዉ ፤
sentences.l: And-this he-said concerning Christ son-of God; and-again he-prophesied concerning crucifixion-his and-he-said: when they-vexed(?)-them serpents the-children-of Israel, they-cried-out to Moses, and-Moses-also he-cried-out to God that he-save-them from-beast-of earth(?); and-he-said-to-him: make image-of serpent of-bronze(?) and-hang-it where they-may-see(?)-it; and-every whom-bit-him serpent let-him-look-at that image-of bronze and-he-will-live; and-when they-delayed to-look they-die, and-those-indeed they-looked-at-it and-believed they-live;
sentences.i: He said this about Christ, the Son of God. And again he prophesied about his crucifixion, and said: When serpents tormented (?) the children of Israel, they cried out to Moses, and Moses in turn cried out to God that he might save them from the beast of the earth (?); and God said to him: 'Make an image of a serpent of bronze (?), and hang it up where they may see (?) it; and everyone whom a serpent has bitten, let him look at that bronze image and he will live.' And when they delayed to look, they died; but those who looked at it and believed, lived;
sentences.n: Numbers 21:4-9, the bronze serpent, read as a type of the crucifixion (compare John 3:14). ዘንተ is the accusative 'this'; ተነበየ 'he prophesied' is a tä-stem; ስቅለቱ is ስቅለት 'crucifixion, hanging' + -ሁ 'his'. ሶበ 'when'. አመንደብዎሙ is a 3mp perfect + -ሙ 'them' with the object named after it by ለደቂቀ እስራኤል and አክይስት (plural of ከይሲ) as subject; CRUX: I cannot place the root of አመንደበ (it looks like a four-letter verb), and 'tormented, bit' is guessed from the story (?); ምንዳቤ 'distress' (from memory, unchecked) may belong to it, which would favour 'distressed, tormented'. አውየዉ 'they cried out' (3mp perfect, as in the glossary); ወሙሴሂ is 'and Moses too, in turn' (enclitic -ሂ). ከመ ያድኅኖሙ is ከመ + 3ms subjunctive of አድኅነ 'save' + -ሙ 'them'. አርዌ ምድር 'beast of the earth' (construct) is the standard phrase for a wild animal or serpent (?). ወይቤሎ 'and he said to him'; ግበር 'make!' (imperative); ሣዕለ is ሥዕል 'image' with a variant spelling (ሣ for ሥ; the next occurrence is ሥዕለ), in the construct before ከይሲ 'serpent'. ዘብርት is ዘ- + ብርት, taken as 'bronze' from the Numbers story (?). ወስቅሎ is the imperative ስቅል 'hang!' + -ዎ 'it'. CRUX: ኀበ ይትኤመርዎ 'where they may see it' is a tä-stem imperfect with -ዎ 'it'; the root (ኣመረ, seeing/showing) is not secure (?). ዘነሰኮ is ዘ- 'whom' + ነሰከ 'bit' + -ዎ 'him' (ከ + ዎ fuse as -ኮ); ይነጽሮ is the 3ms jussive of ነጸረ 'look' + -ዎ, anticipating ለውእቱ ሥዕለ ብርት 'that bronze image'; ወይሕየው 'and he will live'. ተህከዩ 'they delayed, were slow' (3mp perfect; the root ተህከየ is a guess (?)) + ነጽሮ 'to look' (infinitive); ይመውቱ 'they die'; ወእለሰ 'and those, however'; ነጸርዎ 'they looked at it'; የሐይዉ 'they live'.

sentences.t: ወከማሁ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ተህከዩ ፡ ወኢአምኑ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ የኀልቁ ፡ በሲኦል ፡ ወእለሰ ፡ አምኑ ፡ ወሰምዑ ፡ ይወርሱ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ሕይወት ፡ ዘለዓለም ፡ ኀበ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ደዌ ፡ ወሕማም ፡ ዘለዓለም ።
sentences.l: And-likewise Christ: for-those who-delayed and-not-believed in-him they-perish in-Sheol, and-those-indeed believed and-heard they-inherit land-of life of-eternity where there-is-not sickness and-pain forever.
sentences.i: So it is with Christ: those who delayed and did not believe in him perish in Sheol, but those who believed and heard inherit the land of eternal life, where there is no sickness or pain for ever.
sentences.n: ወከማሁ 'and likewise' (ከማ 'like' + -ሁ). ለእለ is ለ- + እለ 'those who'; it names the group the verb is about ('as for those who...'), and the verb የኀልቁ 'they perish' (3mp imperfect of ኀልቀ) follows after ቦቱ 'in him' (በ- + -ቱ; አምነ ቦቱ 'believe in him'). ሲኦል 'Sheol' (the place of the dead, hell); በ- 'in'. ይወርሱ 'they inherit' (3mp imperfect of ወረሰ). ምድረ ሕይወት is a construct chain, 'land of life', and ዘለዓለም is ዘ- + ለዓለም 'of eternity'. ኀበ 'where'; አልቦ 'there is not'; ደዌ 'sickness'; ወሕማም 'and pain'; the last ዘለዓለም is 'for ever'.

sentences.t: ወዘከመሂ ፡ ተህየይዎ ፡ ለክርስቶስ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ንሕነ ፡ ናየድዐክሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-how-also they-rejected(?)-him Christ word-of God, we ourselves we-shall-inform-you;
sentences.i: And how they rejected Christ, the Word of God, we ourselves will make known to you;
sentences.n: ወዘከመሂ is ወ- + ዘከመ 'how, in what way' + enclitic -ሂ 'also'. CRUX: ተህየይዎ is a 3mp perfect + -ዎ 'him' of a tä-stem verb; I read it as 'they turned from, rejected' by analogy with ተሀየየ in earlier parts (spelled with ሀ there, ህ here), and by the sense of the next lines (?). ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'word of God' is a construct chain in the accusative, in apposition to ክርስቶስ (John 1:1; see the same phrase in units 8 and 9). ንሕነ is the independent 'we', emphatic; ናየድዐክሙ 'we shall inform you' is 1cp imperfect of አየድዐ + -ክሙ 'you' (?), as glossed before.

sentences.t: ሶበ ፡ ሐመይዎ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብሉ ፡ ለባሕቲቱኑ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ዘተና ፡ ገሮ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወንሕነሰ ፡ እፎ ፡ ዘኢንሰምዕ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ንእመን ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ወሰምዐ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ማእመሬ ፡ አልባብ ፡ ሐሜቶሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወአንተሰ ፡ በዝየ ፡ ትስእል ፡ ስርየተ ፡ ለሕዝብከ ፡ ወእሙንቱሰ ፡ ሐመዩከ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብሉ ፡ ለነሰ ፡ እፎ ፡ ዘኢይትናገረነ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: When they-slandered(?) Moses the-children-of Israel saying: to-him-alone-(question) to-Moses to-whom he-spoke-to-him God? and-we-indeed how that-not-we-hear word-of God that we-believe in-him? and-he-heard God knower-of hearts murmuring-their of-the-children-of Israel, and-he-said-to-him to-Moses: and-you-indeed here you-ask forgiveness for-your-people, and-they-indeed they-slandered-you saying: to-us-indeed how that-not he-speaks-to-us God?;
sentences.i: When the children of Israel spoke against (?) Moses, saying, 'Was it to Moses alone that God spoke? And as for us, how is it that we do not hear the word of God, that we may believe in him?', God, who knows hearts, heard the murmuring of the children of Israel and said to Moses: 'You are here asking forgiveness for your people, while they speak against you, saying, "And as for us, how is it that God does not speak to us?"';
sentences.n: ሐመይዎ is a 3mp perfect + -ዎ 'him' of ሐመየ 'speak ill of, slander'; the root is inferred from ሐሜት 'slander, murmuring' (?), and ሐሜቶሙ below is that noun + -ሙ 'their'. The object ለሙሴ is named after the verb, and the subject ደቂቀ እስራኤል follows it. እንዘ ይብሉ 'saying'. ለባሕቲቱኑ is ለ- + ባሕቲት 'solitude' + -ሁ 'his' + the question particle -ኑ: 'to himself alone, then?' ዘተና ገሮ is one word split by the wordspace, ዘ-ተናገሮ: ዘ- 'to whom' + ተናገረ 'spoke' + -ዎ 'him'. ወንሕነሰ 'and as for us'; እፎ 'how?'; ዘኢንሰምዕ 'that we do not hear'; ከመ ንእመን 'that we may believe' (1cp subjunctive of አምነ). ማእመሬ አልባብ 'knower of hearts' (construct; ማእመር, agent noun of አእመረ). ወአንተሰ 'and you, indeed'; ትስእል 'you ask' (2ms imperfect of ሰአለ); ስርየተ 'forgiveness' (accusative of ስርየት); ሐመዩከ 'they slandered you' (3mp perfect + -ከ). ለነሰ is ለ- 'to' + -ነ 'us' + -ሰ 'as for'; ዘኢይትናገረነ 'that he does not speak to us' (tä-stem, 3ms imperfect + -ነ 'us').

sentences.t: ወይእዜኒ ፡ ለእመ ፡ አምኑኒ ፡ ይምጽኡ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ዝየ ፡ ወበሎሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያንጽሑ ፡ ርእሶሙ ፡ ወይኅፅቡ ፡ አልባሲሆሙ ፡ ወይዕርጉ ፡ ዐበይተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ከመ ፡ ይስምዑ ፡ ዘአነ ፡ እኤዝዞሙ ፡ ወይስምዑ ፡ ቃልየ ፡ ወይግበሩ ፡ ትእዛዝየ ፡ ዘአነ ፡ አዘዝኩ ፤
sentences.l: And-now-indeed if they-believed-me(?) let-them-come to-me with-you here, and-say to-them that they-purify heads-their and-wash garments-their, and-let-go-up nobles-of Israel that they-hear what I I-command-them, and-let-them-hear word-my and-do commandment-my which I I-commanded;
sentences.i: 'And now, if they believe me (?), let them come to me here with you. Tell them to cleanse themselves and wash their garments, and let the nobles of Israel go up, that they may hear what I command them; let them hear my word and keep my commandment, which I have commanded';
sentences.n: Exodus 19:10-15 (purifying and washing garments before Sinai) and 24:1. ወይእዜኒ 'and now' (enclitic -ኒ). ለእመ አምኑኒ is ለእመ 'if' + the 3mp perfect አምኑ + -ኒ, which is either '-ኒ me' (God speaking: 'if they believe me') or the enclitic 'also, indeed'; I take 'me' as the fitter sense in God's mouth (?). ይምጽኡ 'let them come' (3mp jussive); ኀቤየ 'to me'; ምስሌከ 'with you'. ወበሎሙ 'and say to them' (imperative). ከመ ያንጽሑ ርእሶሙ is a causative (Aʾ) subjunctive, 'that they cleanse their heads', an idiom for 'cleanse themselves'; ወይኅፅቡ 'and let them wash' (jussive). ዐበይተ እስራኤል 'the great ones, nobles of Israel' (construct plural of ዐቢይ). ወይዕርጉ 'let them go up'. ዘአነ እኤዝዞሙ is ዘ- 'what' + አነ 'I' + 1cs imperfect of አዘዘ 'command' + -ሙ 'them'; ቃልየ 'my word', ትእዛዝየ 'my commandment', and ዘአነ አዘዝኩ 'which I commanded' (1cs perfect).

sentences.t: ወተአዚዞ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ነገሮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወሰገዲ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአንጽሑ ፡ ርእሶሙ ፡ በሣልስት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ወዐርጉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ሲና ፡ ፸ ፡ አእሩገ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወወፅኡ ፡ እምትዕይንት ፡ ወዐርጉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ሲና ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይትራሐቁ ፡ መጠነ ፡ ምንዳፈ ፡ ሐጽ ፡ ቆሙ ፡ በበ፩ ፡ በአንጻረ ፡ ቢጹ ፡ ወእሙንቱሰ ፡ መጠነ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ ፈተኑ ፡ ምግባሮሙ ፡ ወኢክህሉ ፡ ዐሪገ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቆባር ፡ ምስለ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአኀዞሙ ፡ ረዓድ ፡ ወድንጋፄ ፡ ወደፈኖሙ ፡ ጽላሎተ ፡ ሞት ፡ ወሰምዑ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ቀርን ፡ ወዕንዚራ ፡ ወጽልመት ፡ ወነፋስ ፤
sentences.l: And-obeying Moses he-told-them the-children-of Israel, and-bowed the-people to-God, and-they-purified heads-their on-third day, and-went-up to mount-of Sinai seventy elders-of Israel, and-they-came-out from-camp and-went-up to mount-of Sinai while they-kept-apart(?) as-far-as throw-of arrow(?), stood each-one opposite-of his-fellow; and-they-indeed as-far-as in-them they-examined(?) deeds-their and-not-they-could to-go-up into tent(?) with Moses, and-seized-them trembling and-terror, and-covered(?)-them shadow-of death, and-they-heard sound-of horn and-harp(?) and-darkness and-wind;
sentences.i: Moses obeyed and told the children of Israel, and the people bowed down to God. They cleansed themselves on the third day, and seventy elders of Israel went up to Mount Sinai. They came out of the camp and went up to Mount Sinai, keeping apart (?) about a bowshot (?), each standing opposite his fellow. But they, as far as it lay in them (?), examined (?) their deeds, and were not able to go up into the tent (?) with Moses. Trembling and terror seized them, the shadow of death covered them, and they heard the sound of the horn and the harp (?), and the darkness and the wind;
sentences.n: Exodus 19-20 and 24:1, 9 (the elders at Sinai), with Hebrews 12:18-21. ወተአዚዞ is a converb (-ዎ ending) of the tä-stem ተአዘዘ, 'obeying', with Moses as its subject; ነገሮሙ is the verb ነገረ 'he told' + -ሙ 'them', not the noun ነገር 'word' glossed elsewhere. ወሰገዲ 'and they bowed' is written -ዲ for -ዱ (?). ወአንጽሑ ርእሶሙ is the Aʾ perfect 'they cleansed their heads', as in the last unit; በሣልስት ዕለት 'on the third day' (Exodus 19:11). ፸ is 'seventy' (spoken ሰብዓ); አእሩገ is the construct 'elders of'. ዐርጉ and ወፅኡ are 3mp perfects. ትዕይንት 'camp' (?). እንዘ ይትራሐቁ is a tä-stem 'keeping apart from one another, at a distance' (?), and መጠነ ምንዳፈ ሐጽ means 'as far as a throw/shot of an arrow' (?), my reading of ምንዳፍ as 'shooting' is a guess. በበ፩ is በበ 'each, by' + ፩ (spoken አሐዱ 'one'), 'one by one'; በአንጻረ is በ- + አንጻር 'in front of', construct before ቢጹ 'his fellow'. CRUX: ወእሙንቱሰ መጠነ ቦሙ ፈተኑ ምግባሮሙ: ቦሙ 'in them', ፈተነ 'test, examine' (?); 'examined their deeds as far as was in them' is my best reading (?) and the clause could mean 'they were tried in their deeds'. ኢክህሉ ዐሪገ 'they could not go up' (infinitive). ቆባር, here 'tent' (?), unattested in my aids. አኀዞሙ 'seized them'; ረዓድ 'trembling', ድንጋፄ 'terror'. ደፈኖሙ is 'covered them' (ደፈነ, ?); ጽላሎተ ሞት 'the shadow of death' is an accusative construct, either a second object or the subject in accusative form (compare Psalm 23:4). ቃለ is the construct 'sound of'; ዕንዚራ is a stringed instrument (?); 'darkness and wind' are joined to the list, so 'heard' is stretched over them.

sentences.t: ወቦአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቆባር ፡ ወተናገረ ፡ ምስለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወሰምዑ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ዐበይተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ፈርሁ ፡ ወርዕዲ ፡ ወኢክህሉ ፡ ቀዊመ ፡ እምብዝኀ ፡ ፍርሀት ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ልቦሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-entered Moses into tent and-spoke with God, and-heard all-of-them nobles-of Israel that word-of God; they-feared and-trembled and-not-they-could to-stand from-abundance-of fear which-in heart-their;
sentences.i: Moses entered the tent and spoke with God, and all the nobles of Israel heard that word of God; they were afraid and trembled, and could not stand for the great fear in their hearts;
sentences.n: ወቦአ 'and he entered' (3ms perfect, G); ተናገረ ምስለ 'spoke with'. ኵሎሙ is 'all of them', before ዐበይተ እስራኤል (construct). ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር is 'that word of God', the demonstrative placed before its noun; ቃለ is the construct. ፈርሁ 'they feared' (3mp perfect); ወርዕዲ 'and they trembled' (ርዕደ), written -ዲ for -ዱ as in ሰገዲ (?). ኢክህሉ ቀዊመ 'they could not stand' (infinitive of ቆመ). እምብዝኀ ፍርሀት is እም- 'from' + the construct ብዝኅ 'abundance of' + ፍርሀት 'fear'; ዘውስተ ልቦሙ 'which was in their heart'.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ወፅአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ይቤልዎ ፡ ኢንሰምዓ ፡ ለዛቲ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢንሙት ፡ በድንጋፄ ፡ ወናሁ ፡ አእመርነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ተናገረከ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወለእመቦ ፡ ዘይነግረነኬ ፡ አንተ ፡ ስማዕ ፡ ወንግረነ ፡ ወኩነነ ፡ አፈ ፡ በኀበ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወንከውኖ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ዚአሁ ፡ ትሬእዩኑ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ክሕድዎ ፡ ለክርስቶስ ፡ ወይቤሉ ፡ ኢንሰምዖ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ቃል ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢንሙት ፡ በድንጋፄ ፤
sentences.l: And-when came-out Moses they-said-to-him: not-we-hear-it this word-of God, that not-we-die in-terror; and-behold we-know that he-spoke-to-you God; and-if-there-is-one who-tells-us-indeed, you hear and-tell-us, and-be-for-us mouth before God, and-we-shall-be-to-him people own-his. Do-you-see how they-denied Christ and-they-said: not-we-hear-it that word, that not-we-die in-terror;
sentences.i: And when Moses came out, they said to him: 'Let us not hear this word of God, lest we die of terror. Behold, we know that God has spoken to you. And if there is anyone to tell us, you listen and tell us, and be a mouth for us before God, and we shall be his own people.' Do you see how they denied Christ, saying, 'Let us not hear that Word, lest we die of terror'?
sentences.n: ይቤልዎ 'they said to him' (ይቤሉ + ሎ, written -ልዎ). ኢንሰምዓ is the 1cp jussive negated, 'let us not hear', with -ኣ '(her) it' agreeing with the feminine demonstrative ለዛቲ (ዛቲ with the masculine ቃል is odd, ?); ከመ ኢንሙት 'lest we die' (1cp jussive); በድንጋፄ 'in terror'. ወናሁ አእመርነ 'and behold, we know' (1cp perfect), ከመ ተናገረከ 'that he has spoken to you'. ወለእመቦ is ወ- + ለእመ 'if' + ቦ 'there is'; ዘይነግረነኬ is 'who will tell us' (3ms imperfect + -ነ 'us') with the emphatic enclitic -ኬ. Imperatives: ስማዕ 'hear!', ንግረነ 'tell us!', ኩነነ 'be (for) us!'. አፈ በኀበ እግዚኣብሔር 'a mouth before God'. ንከውኖ is ንከውን 'we shall be' + -ዎ 'to him', then ሕዝበ ዚአሁ 'a people his own'. ትሬእዩኑ is 2mp imperfect of ርእየ + -ኑ (question particle), 'do you see?', the writer turning to the reader. ዘከመ ክሕድዎ ለክርስቶስ is 'how they denied Christ' (ክሕደ + -ዎ); the clause runs on into ወይቤሉ 'and they said'. ኢንሰምዖ ... ለውእቱ ቃል is 'let us not hear it (m.)'.

sentences.i: Now the Word of God is Christ.
sentences.n: ወቃልሰ is ወ- + ቃል 'word, Word' + emphatic -ሰ; ዘእግዚኣብሔር is ዘ- 'of' + God, so 'the Word of God'; ውእቱ is the copula, 'is' (John 1:1, 1:14; Revelation 19:13).

sentences.t: ወአሜሃ ፡ ዘይቤሉ ፡ ኢንስምዖ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ቃል ፡ ኢነአምኖ ፡ ለክርስቶስ ፡ ብሂል ፨
sentences.l: And-then what they-said not-we-hear that word not-we-believe Christ, that-is.
sentences.i: So when they said, 'Let us not hear that Word', it means, 'We do not believe Christ.'
sentences.n: ወአሜሃ 'and then, so'. ዘይቤሉ is ዘ- 'what' + ይቤሉ 'they said'. ኢንስምዖ is the same 1cp jussive as ኢንሰምዖ above (spelled with ስ here). ኢነአምኖ is ኢ- + ነአምን (1cp imperfect indicative of አምነ, not the subjunctive ንእመን of unit 5) + -ዎ 'him', with Christ named after it by ለ-. ብሂል 'saying, that is' closes the explanation; ፨ closes the section (the source has no paragraph break here).

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ሰአለ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወይቤ ፡ አርእየኒ ፡ ገጽከ ፤
sentences.l: And-again Moses-asked of God and-said: show-me face-your;
sentences.i: And again Moses asked of God, and said: 'Show me your face';
sentences.n: Exodus 33:18. ወካዕበ 'and again'; ሰአለ ኀበ 'he asked of'. አርእየኒ is the Aʾ imperative of ርእየ, 'show!', + -ኒ 'me'; ገጽከ is ገጽ 'face' + -ከ 'your', the object of the imperative.

sentences.t: ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ እስመ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘይክል ፡ ርኢየ ፡ ገጽየ ፡ ወየሐዩ ፡ ወባሕቱ ፡ ከመ ፡ መጽሔት ፡ ሚጥ ፡ ገጽከ ፡ ለምዕራብ ፡ ወትሬኢ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ኰኵሕ ፡ መጽሔተ ፡ ገጽየ ፤
sentences.l: And-he-said-to-him God to-Moses: for there-is-not who can to-see face-my and-live; but as mirror(?) turn face-your to-west and-you-will-see in-rock mirror(?)-of face-my;
sentences.i: And God said to Moses: 'For no one can see my face and live; but, as at a mirror (?), turn your face to the west, and you will see in the rock a mirror (?) of my face';
sentences.n: Exodus 33:20-23. እስመ 'for'; አልቦ ዘይክል 'there is no one who can'; ርኢየ is the infinitive 'to see'. ወየሐዩ 'and live' is a plural-looking form of ሐይወ beside the singular ዘይክል (?). ባሕቱ 'but'. ሚጥ is the imperative of ሜጠ 'turn'; ለምዕራብ is ለ- 'to' + ምዕራብ 'west'. ከመ መጽሔት 'like a mirror' (?): መጽሔት I read as 'mirror', and the construct መጽሔተ ገጽየ as 'mirror of my face', i.e. a reflection; the lexical call is uncertain (?). ወትሬኢ 'and you will see' (2ms imperfect); በውስተ ኰኵሕ 'in the rock'.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ርእየ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ጽላሎተ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ በርሀ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ምስብዒተ ፡ እምነ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ እስከ ፡ ኢይክሉ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ነጽሮተ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ በግላ ፤
sentences.l: And-when saw Moses shadow-of face-his of-God, shone face-his sevenfold(?) more-than the-sun, until not-they-could the-children-of Israel looking-at face-his except by-veil(?);
sentences.i: And when Moses saw the shadow of God's face, his own face shone sevenfold (?) brighter than the sun, so that the children of Israel could not look at his face except through a veil (?);
sentences.n: Exodus 34:29-35. ጽላሎተ ገጹ ለእግዚኣብሔር is 'the shadow of his face, of God' (the suffix anticipates the owner, named by ለ-). በርሀ 'shone' (3ms perfect); ገጹ is Moses' face, the subject. ምስብዒተ 'sevenfold' (?), as glossed before; እምነ ፀሐይ 'more than the sun'. እስከ ኢይክሉ 'until, so that they could not' (3mp imperfect of ከሀለ). ነጽሮተ ገጹ 'looking at his face'; ዘእንበለ 'except, without'. CRUX: በግላ is በ- + ግላ, which I read as 'veil', from Exodus 34:33-35 and the next unit; the word is not in my aids (?).

sentences.t: ወርእየ ፡ አሜሃኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢፈተዉ ፡ ይርአዩ ፡ ገጸ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ አላ ፡ ይቤልዎ ፡ ግበር ፡ ለነ ፡ ግላ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢንርአይ ፡ ገጽከ ፤
sentences.l: And-he-saw(?) then-also that not-they-wished to-see face-of God, but they-said-to-him: make for-us veil(?) that not-we-see face-your;
sentences.i: And then too Moses saw (?) that they did not wish to see the face of God, but they said to him: 'Make us a veil (?), that we may not see your face';
sentences.n: ወርእየ is a 3ms perfect, 'he saw': the form is active, not passive, and no subject is stated; Moses, the subject of the last unit, is likeliest ('Moses saw', ?), an impersonal 'one saw' being possible. አሜሃኒ 'even then' (አሜሃ + -ኒ). ከመ ኢፈተዉ ይርአዩ 'that they did not wish to see' (ፈተወ 'wish, love', 3mp perfect, then a subjunctive). አላ 'but'; ይቤልዎ 'they said to him'; ግበር ለነ 'make for us'. ግላ is read as 'veil' (?), as in the last unit. ከመ ኢንርአይ 'that we may not see' (1cp subjunctive negated).

sentences.t: ወዘንተ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይቤሉ ፡ ይትዐወቅ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጸልእዎ ፡ ለክርስቶስ ፡ ሰሚዐ ፡ ቃሉ ፡ ወርኢየ ፡ ገጹ ።
sentences.l: And-this when they-said it-is-known that they-hated Christ, hearing word-his and-seeing face-his.
sentences.i: And from their saying this it is known that they hated Christ, in hearing his word and seeing his face.
sentences.n: ወዘንተ ሶበ ይቤሉ is 'and when they said this', the accusative ዘንተ. ይትዐወቅ 'it is known' (passive, tä-stem). ጸልእዎ is the 3mp perfect of ጸልአ 'hate' + -ዎ 'him', with Christ named after it by ለ-. ሰሚዐ and ርኢየ are infinitives, 'hearing' and 'seeing', each with its possessive (ቃሉ 'his word', ገጹ 'his face'); the sense is that hearing and seeing him was what they would not bear.
